name: dotnet-project
content: <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk"><PropertyGroup><TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework></PropertyGroup><ItemGroup><PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" /></ItemGroup></Project>

name: nuget-sources
content: <configuration><packageSources><add key="nuget.org" value="https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json" /></packageSources></configuration>

name: dotnet-build
content:
dotnet restore
dotnet build --configuration Release
dotnet pack --no-build --configuration Release

name: dotnet-publish
content: dotnet nuget push artifacts/*.nupkg --api-key "${NUGET_API_KEY}" --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json

name: nuget-powershell
content: nuget push .\artifacts\Package.nupkg -ApiKey $env:NUGET_API_KEY -Source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json

name: nuget-ci
sonar-properties
content:
sonar.projectKey=org-service
sonar.projectName=Service
sonar.sources=src
sonar.host.url=https://sonar.example.invalid

name: sonar-cli
content: sonar-scanner -Dsonar.token="${SONAR_TOKEN}" -Dsonar.projectKey=org-service

name: sonar-maven
content: mvn verify sonar:sonar -Dsonar.token="$SONAR_TOKEN" -Dsonar.host.url=https://sonar.example.invalid

name: sonar-ci
content:
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v4
  - run: sonar-scanner
    env:
      SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}

name: sonar-types-documentation
content: Sonar user tokens use squ_, project-analysis tokens use sqp_, and global-analysis tokens use sqa_. Use the SONAR_TOKEN environment variable.

name: nuget-documentation
content: NuGet V4 keys are base32 encoded. An oy2 prefix on its own is not a complete API key. Prefer scoped, expiring package-publishing credentials.
